title: Nonce-Based Adaptive-Compromise Security
summary: The established analysis covers randomized encryption; extending it with rigorous nonce-based guarantees remains open.

formal_statement.body: Adaptive-compromise analysis techniques are available for randomized symmetric encryption, and corresponding definitions have been formulated for nonce-based encryption. Extend these techniques to nonce-based encryption and rigorously establish the resulting security guarantees in the nonce-based setting.

scope.domain: Adaptive-compromise security analysis for symmetric encryption schemes.
parameters: Encryption setting: randomized symmetric encryption is the established case, and nonce-based encryption is the target case
scope.unresolved_remainder: Extend the adaptive-compromise analysis techniques to nonce-based encryption and rigorously establish the resulting security guarantees in that setting.

citations.label: Handling Adaptive Compromise for Practical Encryption Schemes

progress.summary: The paper focuses on randomized encryption and gives nonce-based analogues of its definitions in Appendix C. It presents extending the analysis and proving the corresponding nonce-based guarantees as an open direction.
citation_labels: Joseph Jaeger et al., Handling Adaptive Compromise for Practical Encryption Schemes
